data.name: Nelida
data.gender_notes: Nelida is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Nelida comes from the Latin word 'nelus' meaning 'little one' and 'dulcis' meaning 'gentle'. This name was commonly given to girls in the Roman Empire and later in Christian Europe. The name Nelida carries the meaning “Gentle, little one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nelida usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nelida total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

Nella is a feminine given name, meaning gift or favor, and is derived from the Latin language, signifying the gift and favor of God.

data.cultural_impact: Nelida was a popular name in Christianity, particularly in Spanish and Portuguese speaking countries. It was given to baby girls as a sign of endearment, as it meant 'little one' and 'gentle'. The name was also associated with the Virgin Mary, who is often referred to as 'auspiciosa Virgo,' which translates to 'the auspicious virgin', due to her gentle traits and nurturing nature towards all mankind.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Nelida can be seen as a reminder to live gently and with compassion towards others, just as the Virgin Mary did towards humankind. The name's Latin origin also connects it to the deeper spiritual traditions of Christianity, as the Latin language was integral in preserving religious texts and traditions. Therefore, the name Nelida can be seen as a spiritual name that invites its bearer to cultivate gentleness, compassion, and a deep appreciation for the rich history and traditions of the Christian faith.
